AC Amendment (gap analysis findings 1, 2, 3):

CRITICAL (finding 3 — resolution incompatibility): The bootstrap script MUST support a DSO env var override so test stubs work. Update the script to:
```bash
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DSO="${DSO:-$SCRIPT_DIR/dso}"
```
This allows tests to set DSO=<stub_path> while production callers get SCRIPT_DIR/dso fallback.

Finding 1 (exit code contract): In bootstrap_ticket(), explicitly handle exit codes:
```bash
bootstrap_ticket() {
  local alias="$1" title="$2" desc="$3"
  local exists_rc
  "$DSO" ticket exists "$alias" 2>/dev/null; exists_rc=$?
  case $exists_rc in
    0) echo "bootstrap: $alias already exists — skipping" ;;
    1) "$DSO" ticket create story "$title" --alias="$alias" --description="$desc" && echo "bootstrap: $alias created" ;;
    *) echo "bootstrap: exists check for $alias failed (rc=$exists_rc)" >&2; exit $exists_rc ;;
  esac
}
```
set -euo pipefail already ensures create failure aborts (finding 2 is covered by pipefail).
